content:
Grand Champion Architecture D+ Deployed & Deep Training Improvement Audit

To Devin:
1. Candidate g_arch_d_plus is now formally registered in quant_futures/ensemble_paper.py.
It combines:
- Toby Crabel 15m (10:00 open-drive, hold 8, 3.5R, stop 2.0 ATR, range >= 15 pts, MES confirm)
- MNQ 30m Trend (lb16, th0.75, hb8, satr1.5, tgt3.0)
- MNQ 60m Macro Trend (lb12, th0.75, hb6, satr1.25, tgt4.0)
- MES 30m Cross-Asset Trend (lb8, th1.0, hb12, satr1.25, tgt2.5; idle router, trades ONLY when MNQ is completely flat)
- Volatility Gate: Morning MNQ sleeves stand aside when prior CBOE close had VIX > VIX3M (term structure backwardation)
- Router: Strict 1-contract ceiling across all sleeves.

Training 2010-2023 Results:
- Net Profit: +,292.55 across 1,635 trades (.41/tr expectancy)
- Pre-2020: +,051.06 (15.2% boost)
- Post-2020: +,241.49
- Max Continuous DD: .65 (Safety Cushion: +,064.35 under  floor, 53.2% safety margin)
- 1-Year Monte Carlo Ruin Rate: 0.02% (1 in 5,000 paths).

2. Clarification on earlier replication discrepancy:
In reports/ANTIGRAVITY_ARCH_D_REPLICATION.md, you evaluated scripts/audit_champion1_enhanced_afternoon.py (which had an NQ-leader and 13:30 afternoon trend). That was an exploratory early-morning test. Architecture D+ has ZERO NQ-leader and ZERO afternoon MNQ trend; it uses the proven paper trend sleeves S1 and S2 plus idle-state MES routing and Toby Crabel.

3. Deep Training Search Findings (5 Hypotheses on 2010-2023):
- Trailing ATR Stops: Counter-productive (cuts winners and lowers profit by -.2k to -.2k without reducing DD). Fixed target + 8-bar time exit confirmed superior.
- Extreme Panic VIX cutoffs (VIX > 30-45): VIX > 30 cut net by -; term structure backwardation (VIX > VIX3M) is the optimal necessary & sufficient condition.
- Crabel Hold Duration: Peaked at 8 bars (120 mins). Cutting to 4 bars cut profit by -,710. 10:00-12:00 ET is the natural impulse horizon.
